388685.title: Slicing Axes-Parallel Rectangles

388685.literal_statement: Let us say that two rectangles in the place are independent if both their $x$- and $y$-axis projections are disjoint. A set of rectangles is then independent if the rectangles are pairwise independent. Suppose that a collection of axes-parallel rectangles contains no independent set of size $m$ or greater. What is the minimal number, $f(m)$, of horizontal and vertical lines needed to slice every rectangle in the collection?

358364.title: The Conforti--Cornuéjols packing problem
358364.exact_scope: Packing property iff MFMC for every finite clutter; hard direction is packing implies MFMC.
358364.literal_statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a clutter. Its packing property means that every minor $\mathcal C'$ satisfies the König property, namely $\alpha_0(\mathcal C')=\beta_1(\mathcal C')$. The max-flow min-cut property is the standard corresponding flow-cut property for a clutter.

**Conforti--Cornuéjols packing problem.** A clutter $\mathcal C$ has the packing property if and only if it has the max-flow min-cut property.

The text states that the converse of the known implication from max-flow min-cut to packing is an unsolved conjecture.

349766.exact_scope: Every finite nice graph and arbitrary edge-dependent three-element subsets of nonzero reals.
349766.literal_statement: Let $G$ be a nice graph, and let $\operatorname{ch}_\Pi^*(G)$ denote the list parameter for the multiplicative labelling problem defined in the paper. **The list multiplicative 1-2-3 bound.** If $G$ is a nice graph, then $\operatorname{ch}_\Pi^*(G) \leq 3$.
